text:
Type: brown leather footstool
Use: resting feet in front of an armchair or sofa, extra seating; living room, study, home office
Style: classic, traditional, contemporary
Materials: smooth dark brown grain leather, stitched panel seams, padded top, short black feet
Colors: dark chocolate brown, black feet
Shape: square box with a plump rounded top and visible seams, straight sides, short round feet, compact and solid
Feel: rich, warm, cozy, refined
Goes with: leather sofas, dark wood, cognac and cream tones, brass lamps; classic studies or traditional living rooms

product.name: TIMSFORS
product.description: Contact areas with soft, dyed-through 1.2 mm thick grain leather that is supple and smooth to the touch.
